name: Steve the Craftsman
desc:
🌎 Create a private server to save your World
⭐ Make sure to join this group and to mark the game as favorite to not miss any update
👍 Like the game to show your support

llm.loop: mine blocks -> craft tools and items -> build in a voxel world -> save the world on a private server
llm.objectives: unclear; free-form building and crafting in a Minecraft-style world
llm.progression: unclear; crafted materials and gear (diamond, netherite)
llm.instructions: create a private server to save your world; join the group and favorite for updates
unique: near one-to-one Minecraft recreation with persistent private-server worlds
monetization_signals: paid items and materials (diamonds, netherite, swords, shulker box)
update_signals: asks players to join group to not miss updates
llm.thumbnails: Steve-like character with pickaxe in front of a voxel village, big game logo
llm.complexity_notes: voxel terrain generation, block editing, crafting and world persistence are nontrivial
